articles.title: Live markets: Bitcoin heads lower late Friday as Warsh takes over at Fed
articles.snippet: Kevin Warsh was sworn in as Fed chairman in a White House ceremony early Friday afternoon.

articles.title: ECB pushes back on euro stablecoin proposals, citing financial stability risks
articles.snippet: The ECB warned EU finance ministers that expanding euro stablecoin issuance could weaken bank lending and complicate monetary policy.

articles.title: AI Startup Says It Will Pay People $2,000 a Month to Masturbate—Yes, Really
articles.snippet: Joi AI is hiring 10 “masturbation consultants” to test its AI-guided masturbation feature and report how it affects stress, sleep, mood, and confidence.

articles.title: Bitcoin Dives Below $75K for First Time in a Month as Crypto Liquidations Near $1 Billion
articles.snippet: Bitcoin touched its lowest price in a month overnight following an awful week for ETFs, which shed over $1.25 billion this week.

articles.title: Crypto, Banks, Policy Experts Press Congress to Modernize Bank Secrecy Act
articles.snippet: A House subcommittee hearing exposed a divide over how far to scale back the 1970-era anti-money laundering law as Trump expands its reach.
